constructor: ggml_cast, with one width equal to the least common multiple of the two GGML block sizes and two rows. All descriptors had null data and buffers during capability queries.
scope: Every ordered type pair containing at least one block type. The 81 scalar pairs are tracked in ggml-scalar-cast-coverage.tsv.
reference_outputs: Every refused pair with an available CPU copy branch ran in the original GGML CPU backend with one thread. The last column contains the exact output bytes from input (13*i modulo 31 minus 15)/8 stored with ggml_set_f32_1d. Empty result columns indicate that no new numerical run was needed for this inventory.
dispatch_authority: ggml_compute_forward_dup in ggml/src/ggml-cpu/ops.cpp, combined with the pinned runtime block sizes, quantization callbacks, and original CPU type table. no_branch, no_encoder and no_decoder are direct CPU coverage classifications.
